---
title: "Gardening checklists"
---

Equipment and planting lists for balcony or small-space gardening.
Incorporated from [issue #2](https://github.com/bastienchassagnol/Housework-items/issues/2).

## Containers {#sec-garden-containers}

- [ ] Flower pots (assorted sizes)
- [ ] Window boxes for balcony ledges
- [ ] Deep grow bags / planter tubs (ideal for tomatoes), **30 L**
  minimum
- [ ] Hanging pots to save space
- [ ] Saucers under pots (to catch runoff)

## Substrate {#sec-garden-substrate}

- [ ] Potting compost
- [ ] Compost (soil improver)
- [ ] Mulch (straw or bark chips)
- [ ] Liquid vegetable fertiliser

## Vegetables and herbs {#sec-garden-crops}

- [ ] Cherry tomatoes, radishes, lettuces, chillies or small peppers
- [ ] Aromatic herbs: basil, parsley, thyme, rosemary, mint, chives
- [ ] Useful or decorative flowers: nasturtiums, French marigolds,
  petunias, geraniums

## Supports {#sec-garden-supports}

- [ ] Stakes or netting for climbing plants

## Gardening tools {#sec-garden-tools}

- [ ] Trowel (hand transplanting spade)
- [ ] Hand cultivator (garden claw)
- [ ] Watering can
- [ ] Spray bottle (for misting leaves)

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-planting-workflow
%%| fig-cap: "Simple planting workflow for balcony crops."
flowchart TD
  A[Choose container ≥ 30 L for tomatoes] --> B[Add drainage + saucer]
  B --> C[Fill with potting compost + compost]
  C --> D[Plant seedling or sow seed]
  D --> E[Stake if needed]
  E --> F[Water + mulch]
  F --> G[Feed with liquid fertiliser during growth]
```
